rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for pent-up resentment or a feeling of having been wronged.

example.english: I still feel a lot of grievance over what happened.
example.traditional: 我對件事仲有一肚怨氣未消。
example.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 gin6 si6 zung6 jau5 jat1 tou5 jyun3 hei3 mei6 siu1

rows.note: Use this for making a complaint to an organization or authority about a problem.

example.english: I have lodged a grievance with management about the noise upstairs.
example.traditional: 我已經向管理處投訴樓上噪音。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ji5 ging1 hoeng3 gun2 lei5 cyu3 tau4 sou3 lau4 soeng6 cou3 jam1

rows.note: Use this for a formal workplace grievance handled through an official complaint or appeal procedure.

example.english: If you disagree with the decision, you can file a formal grievance through the proper procedure.
example.traditional: 如果你唔服個決定，可以按程序提出申訴。
example.jyutping: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 m4 fuk6 go3 kyut3 ding6 ho2 ji5 on3 cing4 zeoi6 tai4 ceot1 san1 sou3
